prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in Katy, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1452; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Photos confirm some details, but there are no independent witnesses.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver lives with the policyholder and is covered as a household member.
text: Officer narrative: On arrival at the scene in Katy, Texas, I found a sideswipe collision between two vehicles that had been changing lanes in the same direction. Driver 1 stated that Driver 2 drifted into the adjacent lane and made contact along the left side of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 2 described the lane change as a normal merge and said the contact was minor. Driver 1 reported back strain and was evaluated at the scene. The reported injury is consistent with the force and direction of the impact, and the damage to both vehicles lines up with the account given by each driver. Photographs taken at the scene confirm several of the positions and damage points described. No independent witnesses were located. Officers confirmed that Passenger was in Driver 1's vehicle at the time of the collision, and Passenger's account matched the sequence described by Driver 1. Nothing in the vehicle history or the inspection suggested earlier damage to the vehicle. Driver 1 resides in the same household as the policyholder and is listed as a covered household member on the policy.
